_header.title: Independent list 2
_header.who: Same design as list 1, from another fresh session of the same model family. 126 lines web-inspired.
_header.blind: Blind for the fixes built on list 1 (checked on it once); later a few slang and brand words of the English-word list and the contraction list were taken from it, so it is in-sample for those parts of the typo corrector.
_header.fields: text (as typed), meaning (restated), triage (red/yellow/green), signs, kind, source; lists 3 and 4 add persona; list 4 adds lang and list
_header.note: Invented messages; no real person. This first line is the header; every other line is one message.
